person_note: This eligible prose collection uses different controlling persons across its autonomous stories, so it is ALTERNATING at book level, consistent with the project's treatment of other prose story collections. The quotes and authorized excerpts expose participating first-person narration in stories such as “Two Talented Bastids” and “Rattlesnakes,” while other sampled stories sustain third-person narration. These are full narrative components rather than dialogue or embedded documents. Confidence is medium because the authorized excerpts establish the first-person strand, while the third-person strand is established primarily by distributed quote evidence rather than an authorized full-story excerpt.
